scope: One Chromium browser instance, separate BrowserContexts/pages and verified distinct V8 isolate IDs. CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage is isolate-wide, not a per-document retained-size census.
At each phase two explicit HeapProfiler.collectGarbage calls run in separate protocol turns. No exposed-gc flag, monkey patch, heap snapshot instrumentation or internal bridge access.

Initial baseline follows normal exact source/parsed-render verification. Parsed-held is sampled before rendering held documents. Rendered-held follows exact verification of every held document. Disposed-held retains caller model references after public dispose. Released drops those references.

usedSize measures live JS heap after forced GC. totalSize is reserved JS heap, not live bytes. embedderHeapUsedSize is separate. backingStorageSize includes ArrayBuffer/external-string backing; it may overlap WASM capacity.

wasmLinearMemoryBytes reads the existing exported WebAssembly.Memory capacity. Memory can retain its high-water size after native free. This is not Rust allocator live/requested bytes, RSS, GPU memory or a separate disjoint total; never add or subtract overlapping counters.
Fixed-count priming is not timed. No performance.now, elapsed-time batches, latency ratio or latency claim. The previous latency report is provenance only.

Each pair uses same workload/count. Per-row order is 8/7 because 15 is odd; opposite imbalance on next count row makes aggregate order exactly balanced. Cases reuse warmed pages; baseline drift and released residuals remain visible.

Small negative deltas can reflect GC/cache effects, not negative allocation. Interpret parsed/rendered marginal heap, disposed-held differences and released residual together. Pair statistics are descriptive.
